programs.title: Decision at Sundown
programs.desc: Western starring Randolph Scott and John Carroll. A man seeking revenge for his wife's death tracks his rival down in the sleepy town of Sundown..

programs.title: Taxi
programs.desc: All-action thriller. Queen Latifah stars as the driver of the fastest taxi in New York, who teams up with an inept cop (Jimmy Fallon) to catch a team of female bank-robbers.

programs.title: Nope
programs.desc: Western-infused sci-fi chiller with Daniel Kaluuya and Keke Palmer as cash-strapped horse trainers who try to supplement their income by filming alien goings-on at their ranch.

programs.title: Monolith
programs.desc: Sci-fi horror with Lily Sullivan as a disgraced journalist investigating mysterious manifestations of vision-inducing - possibly supernatural - black bricks. Matt Vesley directs.

programs.title: Significant Other
programs.desc: Eerie sci-fi horror-thriller with Maika Monroe and Jake Lacy. Extra-terrestrial forces derail a couple's romantic backpacking trip, but in a subtle, non-spaceship kind of a way.

programs.title: D-Day the Sixth of June
programs.desc: Wartime romance set against the background of the D-Day landings, starring Robert Taylor and Dana Wynter. A married American officer embarks on an affair with English nurse.

programs.title: The Longest Day
programs.desc: War drama. Darryl F Zanuck's classic Oscar-winning recreation of the Allied landings in Normandy on 6 June 1944, with an all-star British, American, German and French cast.

programs.title: Spies in Disguise
programs.desc: Animated spy comedy caper with the voice of Will Smith. The 'world's most awesome spy' gets framed and has to go undercover as a pigeon to prove his innocence.

programs.title: Sister Act
programs.desc: Comedy starring Whoopi Goldberg. A casino singer who witnesses a Mob murder goes into hiding at a convent, where she soon has the choir rocking. With Maggie Smith.
